notes.title: Mini update notice
notes.notes:
- Some of the credits have been updated.
- Corrected a typo in the wording of the story.
- Improved so that merchants and sailors level up during automatic trade.
・Improved to display the export and import loading amount on the trade preparation screen.
- Corrected so that when importing manually, the item will be obtained after arriving at the dock.

notes.title: Mini Update Notice
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where money was not being produced when upgrading the lumberjack and cabbage field.
Implemented a fix to lock the FPS to 60.
Added descriptions during the construction mode for the port, lumberjack, mine, and road.
Implemented a fix to prevent roads from becoming transparent when the transparency button is pressed.
Modified the "Build" button in construction mode to open the construction menu.
